title: Algebraic extinction in acyclic compartment models
creator: Anonymous

claims.statement: A specified positive four-state conservative quadratic model satisfies the two source graph hypotheses and has I(t) asymptotic to 18/t^2 and integrated activity log 2.
For every integer m>=2 an admissible m+2-state model has exact algebraic exponent m/(m-1); no uniform extra power beyond one holds across all dimensions.
Under both graph hypotheses and strictly positive initial fractions, at most three states imply exponential bounds for all vanishing coordinates.
The specified four-state tensor has the stated complete discriminant classification of extinction and persistence.
Along a strictly positive trajectory in a transition DAG with nonempty vanishing set, all vanishing coordinates are exponentially bounded iff their limiting transverse Jacobian is Hurwitz.
The aggregate vanishing l1 norm has logarithmic rate s(A); the full-state distance has the same rate when s(A)<0.
